source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相临口，静雷欲爆
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC27 after EP02 SC26 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the almost-broken restraint into the next threshold: Keshadu is essentially at the point of exposure, Shisilang's loss of control keeps the scene combustible, Tuobaye is nearly at the end of what he can endure, and the white-clothed woman's restraint feels as if it can no longer remain fully intact.
title: 真相临口，静雷欲爆

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC26 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC26 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将破，十四郎更乱，拓拔野几近极限，白衣女子的静压已经将裂。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这根绷紧的线继续推到真正爆开的门槛。科沙度几乎只差一句话就能把隐藏援手点破，十四郎的失控让场面越来越危险，拓拔野也快撑到尽头。白衣女子的克制会进一步逼近不可再压下的程度。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐藏援手从几乎暴露推进到真正无法再完全遮住，为后面的明确爆点做直接前置。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained right up to the edge of action; no overt spell spectacle yet unless the actual source beat demands it.
Keshadu should feel closer than ever to naming the hidden line.
Shisilang remains emotionally unstable and combustible.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.
